probe_detail.name: Nothing in the text is removable
Reveal forces a rereading of the setup
Ends on a short final line

final.name: Orthographic noise
final.audit_justification: Measures spelling/grammar/typing noise, an orthographic-habit fingerprint of production rather than the joke's comedic substance.
final.upstream_parent: submission haste and editing or assistance processes

final.name: Reference transformation
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a reference is repurposed into a fresh comic mechanism versus decorative, which is direct comedic craft.

final.name: Idiom or set-phrase reinterpreted literally
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the punchline mechanism itself is a literalized idiom, a substantive comedic device.

final.name: Teller as butt, with the admission doing comic work
final.audit_justification: Distinguishes self-indictment as the actual payoff from mere ornament, i.e. whether the joke's core mechanism works.

final.name: Vivid absurd specificity
final.audit_justification: Scores whether concrete detail functionally supports the punchline, a substantive craft property.

final.name: Era anchoring
final.audit_justification: Pure temporal-tell/topic marker (dated references) explicitly scored apart from whether the reference is good; datedness doesn't plausibly cause better craft.
final.upstream_parent: position in the entry stream and submission timing

final.name: Named topical/political figure or current-event reference
final.audit_justification: A subject-matter/topic marker (presence of a named public figure) scored explicitly apart from cleverness, so it flags topic not funniness.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing relative to news/current-events cycle

final.name: Repost/familiarity framing (retelling-chain position)
final.audit_justification: Flags repost/familiarity framing, a production-history fingerprint, but jokes that have survived retelling may plausibly be selected for being genuinely better.
final.upstream_parent: position in the retelling chain (repost vs. original)

final.name: Audience-management furniture: apologies, disclaimers, hedges, requests
final.audit_justification: Measures non-joke audience-management boilerplate (apologies, disclaimers, tags), explicitly separated from the joke's own quality.
final.upstream_parent: audience management by the poster — insecurity about reception and forum etiquette compliance

final.name: Taboo-register intensity
final.audit_justification: Scores taboo subject-matter intensity only, explicitly excluding whether the taboo use is effective or funny.

final.name: Surprise from withholding the expected punchline
final.audit_justification: Scores a specific comedic mechanism (withheld punchline as the joke), substantive to the humor.

final.name: Template commitment
final.audit_justification: Flags a stock scaffold/template, a boilerplate-format marker explicitly scored apart from goodness, and template use doesn't reliably track genuine craft either way.

final.name: Surprise-coherence balance
final.audit_justification: Directly scores the classic surprise-yet-inevitable balance that defines a well-built punchline.

final.name: Incompleteness: setup with no payoff or pun with no setup
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the joke is structurally functional (has both setup and payoff), bearing directly on whether it works as a joke.

final.name: Concrete image-bearing detail rather than abstract assertion
final.audit_justification: Scores whether concrete imagery is functionally used by the payoff, a substantive craft property akin to X05.

final.name: Wordplay with homophone or near-homophone pivot
final.audit_justification: Scores a specific wordplay mechanism (homophone pivot) that is the substance of the joke.

final.name: Verbosity and setup-to-punch bulk
final.audit_justification: Explicitly a length/structural-bulk measure independent of content or payoff, though elaborate builds could stem from more practiced, genuinely funnier writers.

final.name: Forum-aware framing
final.audit_justification: Flags community/venue-specific framing markers explicitly apart from goodness, though in-group platform savvy could also produce genuinely funnier material for that audience.

final.name: Dual-Coherence Wordplay
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a pun's double meaning is genuinely coherent on both readings, a substantive wordplay-craft property.

final.name: Sourcing-versus-origination traces in the text
final.audit_justification: Flags provenance/transcription traces (quoted, translated, lifted) explicitly apart from originality or quality, though a sourced/heard-elsewhere joke may be pre-selected for being genuinely good.
final.upstream_parent: provenance of the material (transcribed from a comedian, translated, lifted from elsewhere online) versus written for this post

final.name: No self-explanation or apology attached to the pun
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the punchline is trusted to land unassisted versus over-explained, a real delivery-craft dimension of the joke's execution.

final.name: Taboo transformed
final.audit_justification: Scores whether a taboo premise is transformed by a clever mechanism versus relying on shock, a substantive craft distinction.

final.name: Brevity: punchline arrives within ~25 words with no filler
final.audit_justification: Scores economy of delivery (no filler, every word working), a substantive craft property akin to X08 rather than mere brevity.

final.name: Self-referential platform/subreddit meta-humor
final.audit_justification: Flags platform/subreddit-topical subject matter explicitly apart from goodness, though skilled in-group meta-humor could also be genuinely funnier to that community.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction scores topical subject matter -- whether the joke's referent is Reddit/karma/posting -- and says nothing about whether the joke is well-constructed or funny, so a high score is evidence about topic selection and in-group audience targeting, not about comedic quality. It is mixed because platform-reflexive jokes can also be genuinely funnier to this specific voting community, so the same upstream cause plausibly produces real quality alongside the audience-match effect.

final.name: Insider knowledge gate with a self-verifying payoff
final.audit_justification: Scores whether the payoff actually enacts the domain fact it invokes, a substantive comedic mechanism rather than surface topic marker.
